name: debug-console-mcp
description: Project-scoped embedded Linux DUT serial debugging through debug-console-mcp.

interface.longDescription: Activates only in a project containing .target.jsonc. Inspect DUT state and logs, run marker-delimited serial commands, control reset and boot modes, and diagnose embedded Linux startup failures.
defaultPrompt: Check the configured DUT state and summarize its latest boot log
Diagnose the latest serial boot failure
Reset the configured DUT and monitor it until boot completes
